caveats: Identity boundary: Source-reported employment or online persona; do not present this label, account, or image as a verified civil identity.
This record describes a reported employment persona/account cluster, not proof that the apparent identity owner is a DPRK national.

This source-reported persona or account label is not a verified legal or civil identity. Historical observation or page reachability does not establish present ownership, control, activity, affiliation, nationality, sanctions status, or lawful identity; do not contact or target the account holder.

The cited source page at https://6068438.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/6068438/dprk-it-threat-japan.pdf carries an image related to this record. It is not reproduced: citation only, no caching, cropping, biometric use, or facial comparison.
Persona names shown here are labels reported by the cited publisher. They are not asserted to be anyone's legal name, and unrelated real people who share a name are not implicated.
A ProPursuit profile named 'Link' claimed the same GitHub account (Nisos p. 5); Nisos does not attribute 'Link' to the Osamu Odaka persona, so it is not shown as a persona name here.

Nisos assesses, with hedged wording ('appears'), that the same individual was later employed under the name Weitao Wang; see /team/weitao-wang. That assessment is Nisos's, not a fact established here.
The RemoteHub profile has been removed; the link points to the 2024-09-13 Internet Archive capture.
Accounts and handles are historical observations reported by the cited sources. Present control of any account is not asserted, and a persona name is not asserted to be anyone's legal identity.
